content_html_sanitized:
A Parent Asks,
"Why do institutions that are supposed to be helping kids in trouble feel it necessary to lie to them?"

(Marijuananews note: I received this email today. It was gratifying but it also tells a very frightening story. The ideology that drives marijuana prohibition also undermines the effectiveness of both substance abuse prevention and treatment. It also undermines the families of the patients.

Not all the victims of marijuana prohibition have been arrested.)

See
Hazelden Drug Rehab Hustlers Urge Parents To Lie To Children About Marijuana:
"30 years ago marijuana typically contained less than 1 percent THC ...
today marijuana typically contains 15 percent THC."

Dear Mr Cowan,

I recently admitted my son to a drug treatment facility.

Although he has had episodes of serious consequence involving alcohol use alone, the focal point of his treatment has been marijuana.

I found your site today and can't thank-you enough for the wealth of open, honest information.

The one question that remains is, why do institutions that are supposed to be helping kids in trouble feel it necessary to lie to them?

Keep up the good work.

M
